$schema: internal build sheet, not a Railway file
name: Supabase + Edge Functions

upstream.$note: The stable self-hosted snapshot pins all 11 service images as a tested set. UPSTREAM_VERSION and test/upstream.sha256 make every vendored file auditable.

adapter.$note: Six thin owned images package files that Docker Compose bind-mounts but Railway image services cannot. Auth, REST, Realtime, imgproxy, and postgres-meta stay on the exact upstream images.

topology.$note: Ten of the official services are retained. The optional Logflare and Vector override is excluded because Vector needs a Docker socket, which Railway does not expose. Railway logs replace the optional Log Explorer.
topology.$storage: Storage writes to its own Railway volume. imgproxy is omitted because Supabase's file backend hands imgproxy local:// paths, so both processes need one shared filesystem, and a Railway volume cannot attach to two services. Railway's API also cannot provision a bucket instance: bucketCreate returns a project-level bucket whose environment instance never exists, so every bucket reference resolves empty. Verified twice on 2026-08-29 with bucketInstanceDetails and bucketS3Credentials both returning BucketInstance not found.
topology.$functions: The same pinned Functions tree is baked into Studio and Edge Runtime. Updating a function requires changing the adapter repository and redeploying both images because Railway cannot share a writable Functions volume.
topology.$public_edge: Only gateway receives an HTTP domain. Studio is protected by generated HTTP Basic Auth on that same origin, and all API paths route through Envoy.
topology.$ipv6: Railway's private network carries traffic over IPv6, so every service Envoy dials must listen on a v6 socket. Upstream's Docker defaults bind IPv4 only and produce an Envoy 'remote connection failure' while the container itself looks perfectly healthy. Hence GOTRUE_API_HOST, SERVER_HOST, PG_META_HOST and HOSTNAME are :: and PGRST_SERVER_HOST is *. Diagnosed on 2026-08-29 when Studio passed its own healthcheck but every gateway request returned 503.
topology.$secrets: JWT_SECRET is generated once on db. Gateway, Storage, Studio, and Edge Runtime independently derive byte-identical legacy anon and service-role JWTs from fixed claims.

db.$note: The wrapper removes lost+found, initializes PGDATA in a subdirectory, bakes the seven official SQL files, and persists /etc/postgresql-custom inside the one attached volume. Empty ANON_KEY and SERVICE_ROLE_KEY are optional migration overrides; wrappers derive both when blank.

gateway.$note: Envoy differs from upstream only by Railway private DNS hostnames and an unauthenticated direct-response /healthz route. Studio remains Basic Auth protected. The live source project needs one redeploy after its domain is created; template deploys create the domain before first boot.

auth.$note: Email auto-confirm is on so a fresh deploy has a complete signup journey without a fake SMTP server. The listing tells production deployers to configure SMTP and turn auto-confirm off.
auth.$note_bind: GOTRUE_API_HOST is :: rather than upstream's 0.0.0.0. Railway's private network resolves IPv6 first, and a Go listener on :: accepts both families.
auth.$note_healthcheck: Deliberately no healthcheckPath. GoTrue applies more than a hundred first-boot migrations before it listens, which overruns Railway's healthcheck window, and Railway then kills the container mid-migration and retries forever. Proven on 2026-08-29: with the healthcheck removed the same image logged 'GoTrue API started on: [::]:9999' and every migration applied. Envoy health-checks the auth cluster itself, so the gateway still refuses to route until Auth answers.

realtime-dev.$note: The service name must remain realtime-dev. The upstream tenant is seeded with that identifier and Realtime routing depends on it.

storage.$note: Objects live on this service's own Railway volume. The wrapper derives ANON_KEY and SERVICE_KEY when the db overrides are blank. GLOBAL_S3_BUCKET, TENANT_ID, and REGION keep upstream's stub values because the file backend never reads them.

functions.$note: The image contains upstream's dispatcher and hello function. Fork the adapter, add function directories, and redeploy Functions plus Studio to add code.

studio.$note: Studio is private behind the gateway's Basic Auth. Its wrapper derives API keys and contains the same read-only Functions tree as Edge Runtime. JWT_SECRET is required by the wrapper's key derivation; upstream Studio itself reads AUTH_JWT_SECRET, so both are set to the same value.

pooler.$note: The wrapper bakes upstream pooler.exs and applies migrations before starting Supavisor. The public TCP proxy exposes transaction pooling on port 6543.

empiricalJourney: Open gateway with generated DASHBOARD_USERNAME and DASHBOARD_PASSWORD
Create a table and row in Studio, then read it through REST
Sign up and sign in through Auth with email auto-confirm
Create a Storage bucket, upload a file, and read it back
Invoke /functions/v1/hello and verify Realtime receives a database change
Connect through both direct Postgres and Supavisor TCP proxies

deliberatelyOmitted.Logflare and Vector: Optional upstream override. Vector requires the Docker socket and is incompatible with Railway. Railway service logs remain available.
deliberatelyOmitted.imgproxy and image transformation: The Storage file backend passes imgproxy local:// paths, so the two processes must share one filesystem. A Railway volume attaches to exactly one service, and the Railway API cannot provision the S3 bucket that would remove the shared-filesystem requirement. Uploads, downloads, signed URLs, and the S3 protocol endpoint all work; only resizing is unavailable. Deployers who need transforms can point Storage at an external S3 provider and add an imgproxy service.
deliberatelyOmitted.asymmetric and opaque API keys: The stable v0.8.0 compose defaults to legacy HS256 keys. Empty override variables keep the documented migration path without forcing six generated values to stay synchronized.
deliberatelyOmitted.live Studio function editing: Studio and Edge Runtime cannot share a Railway volume. Function code is immutable and changed through the adapter repository.
